The 2024 Chrysler Pacifica Plug-In Hybrid Select combines the passenger and cargo versatility of a full-size minivan with the efficiency and everyday convenience of plug-in hybrid power. 2016 Chrysler Town & Country Limited: Executive Luxury Meets Ultimate Family Versatility
Smooth Pentastar V6 Power and Refined Road Manners
The 2016 Chrysler Town & Country Limited stands as the pinnacle of luxury family transport, combining classic American elegance with effortless long-distance performance. Powered by Chrysler’s award-winning 3.6-liter Pentastar V6 engine generating a muscular 283 horsepower and 260 lb-ft of torque, this flagship minivan delivers prompt passing power and whisper-quiet highway cruising. Mated to a smooth 6-speed automatic transmission, the power delivery is seamless whether navigating city streets or embarking on cross-country road trips. Its Touring-tuned suspension glides over road imperfections, delivering a plush, relaxed ride for all seven passengers.

Executive Nappa Leather Cabin & First-Class Amenities
Step inside the top-tier Limited trim to experience an ultra-luxurious sanctuary loaded with high-end materials. The cabin is wrapped in supple, perforated Nappa leather-trimmed seating accented by rich woodgrain inserts and satin chrome touches. Both the driver and front passenger enjoy 8-way power-adjustable, multi-stage heated bucket seats, while second-row passengers relax in heated captain’s chairs.

Class-Exclusive Power 3rd-Row Stow 'n Go®: At the single touch of a button, the 60/40 split-bench 3rd-row seats automatically fold, flip, or stow completely flat into the floor, expanding cargo volume to a massive 143.8 cubic feet without lifting a heavy seat cushion.

Dual-Screen Rear Entertainment: Keeps rear passengers thoroughly entertained with a factory-installed Dual DVD/Blu-ray™ system with dual high-resolution screens, wireless headphones, and HDMI inputs for gaming consoles.

All-Weather Comfort: Includes a heated leather-wrapped steering wheel, tri-zone automatic climate control, integrated second- and third-row sunshades, and a premium 506-watt 9-speaker audio system.

Distinctive Style and Comprehensive SafetyTec™ Suite
Visually, the Limited trim commands attention with its striking chrome-accented grille, chrome exterior mirrors, polished 17-inch aluminum wheels, and high-intensity discharge (HID) Xenon headlights that illuminate the darkest country roads with brilliant clarity.

Safety is built into every detail. The 2016 Town & Country Limited comes standard with Chrysler's SafetyTec™ Package, featuring:

Blind Spot Monitoring & Rear Cross Path Detection: Alerts you to vehicles in your blind spots or approaching from the sides when backing out of tight parking spots.

ParkSense® Rear Park Assist & ParkView® Camera: Provides clear visual grid lines and audible alerts to make parallel parking and backing up effortless.

Complete Airbag Canopy: Standard multi-stage front airbags, driver's knee blocker, seat-mounted side airbags, and three-row side-curtain airbags offer total peace of mind.
